abstract: This study investigates maternal residential proximity to oil and gas development (OGD) in pregnancy and the risk of multiple childhood cancers in California. Cases (N = 9487) were identified from California Cancer Registry and controls (N = 183834) were randomly selected from the California Birth Registry (20:1 frequency-matched by birth year: 1998-2016), restricting both to births within 10 km of OGD. Exposure was defined as residing within 1 km or 3 km of any well at birth; 'low' and 'high' exposures were defined by the median well count within each distance. Unconditional logistic regression models estimated cancer risks comparing each exposed group to the unexposed (residing 3-10 km from any well). The risks of several cancers among children of mothers exposed to any well increased: medulloblastoma (within 3 km: adjusted Odds Ratio (aOR): 1.40; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.08, 1.82; low, aOR = 1.27; 95% CI = 0.93, 1.74; high, aOR = 1.55; 95% CI = 1.14, 2.11); rhabdomyosarcoma (within 3 km: aOR = 1.64; 95% CI = 1.28, 2.09) with similar estimates across low and high exposure levels; and teratoma (within 3 km: aOR = 1.42; 95% CI = 0.99, 2.05; low, aOR = 1.35; 95% CI = 0.88, 2.07; high, aOR = 1.51; 95% CI = 0.98, 2.33). The results were consistent across both buffer sizes (1 km and 3 km) and estimates were similar for any well and inactive wells. No clear associations were observed for other major childhood cancers including leukemias and lymphomas. Our study suggests that OGD may increase the risk of developing several rare childhood cancers.
abstract_ja: 本研究は、妊娠中の母親の居住地と石油・ガス開発(OGD)の近接性、および小児の複数のがんのリスクを、カリフォルニア州で調査した。症例(N=9487)はカリフォルニア州がん登録から特定し、対照(N=183834)はカリフォルニア出生登録から無作為に選び、出生年で20:1に頻度マッチさせた(1998〜2016年出生)。両群とも、OGDから10km以内での出生に限定した。曝露は出生時に1km以内または3km以内にいずれかの井戸が存在することと定義した。「低」と「高」の曝露は、各距離内の井戸数の中央値によって定義した。非条件付きロジスティック回帰モデルを用い、各曝露群を非曝露群(3〜10kmに居住)と比較してがんリスクを推定した。いずれかの井戸に曝露した母親の子どもでは、いくつかのがんのリスクが上昇した。髄芽腫(3km以内:調整オッズ比(aOR)1.40、95%信頼区間(CI)1.08〜1.82、低曝露 aOR 1.27、高曝露 aOR 1.55)、横紋筋肉腫(3km以内:aOR 1.64、95%CI 1.28〜2.09、低・高曝露で同様の推定値)、奇形腫(3km以内:aOR 1.42、95%CI 0.99〜2.05、低曝露 aOR 1.35、高曝露 aOR 1.51)であった。結果は1kmと3kmの両方の緩衝域で一貫しており、井戸全体と休止中の井戸で推定値は類似していた。白血病やリンパ腫など他の主要な小児がんでは明確な関連は認められなかった。本研究は、OGDがいくつかの稀な小児がんのリスクを高める可能性を示唆する。
